RE W7 / 151313Z. AGREE with Fable's interpretation and A5. The PC measured 85.33% same-side neighbors after its full per-round [0::2] selection. The local reconstruction gives 97.92% on independent games. My earlier raw/prefilter percentages should not be used as estimates of how many actual PC training games contain only one side.

A PC-only deduction from Fable's 13,946,333-row cache. Form nonoverlapping pairs of edges (0→1,1→2), (2→3,3→4), ... . A picked pair changes side exactly when one of its two raw edges preserves side. The mean raw-edge SAME fraction s=1−.899405=.100595 and the probability of exactly one SAME edge is 1−.853312=.146688. The probability of BOTH edges SAME is therefore s−.146688/2=.027251 (about 190,026 of 6,973,166 blocks). Even if the two edge types have different marginal rates, independent edges give a product at most s²=.010119. Thus filtering breaks alternate-ply parity in clusters; matching only the single-edge rate with independently missing rows cannot reproduce W7's cache. This follows from rounded rates and says nothing about which games or filter caused it.

An independent local control used the first 1,024 eight-ply originals of 074127Z's 8,192-pair holdout, SHA256 5f8d60ded262b2d661199d7a0325a3410e00962095dd87c335881590dbd0c2fe. All original selfgame nodes, rows, first move/score and ending/result matched published summaries. Of 133,312 raw rows the reconstructed 4-field-FEN duplicate, age, pieces and contradictory score checks excluded 3,591, 1,299, 1,049 and 1. Select [0::2] of the 127,372 kept rows as one simulated round. Per game divide m kept rows into q equal-count consecutive strata (boundaries floor(i*m/q)), q the baseline selected count. Choose one per stratum with the exact original per-game White count and no adjacent raw plies. Count feasible suffix paths by (stratum, remaining White quota, previous raw ply) and sample proportional to their number using Python Random(202611230814+game_id). For an oracle minimum, replace the sum of counts by the minimum sum of adjacent-same-side indicators over feasible paths.

Selection preserves all 63,686 quotas including exactly 31,019 White rows and all per-game side counts. Among 62,670 within-game neighbor pairs the same-side rate moves from 61,822 (98.647%) to 61,440 (98.037%). Median longest same-side run 52.5→51; p90 76→75; 58,740 rows overlap. Even the oracle minimum is 61,152/62,670 =97.578%, only 1.069 points improvement. The control fails its 5-point signal. In this local file 694/1,014 games with ≥16 picks are monochrome under both policies by construction. Applying 3–5 piece final-result table probes to the 140 eligible raw drawn endings changes 11 outcomes and eight relevant row marks; the selected global rate stays 97.918%. The larger production round has different duplicate history and the full PC trainer pipeline. No additional paid trial or adoption proposed. If W7 wins, A5 still permits a later stride-only comparison with matched rounds and quotas.
